programme.desc: L'entreprise de tuning Arden de Krefeld est spécialisée dans les marques britanniques Mini, Bentley, Range Rover et Jaguar. L'AJ23 est une Jaguar F-Type R modifiée qui est déjà un modèle de série.

programme.title: Tuning
programme.desc: Déjà dans la huitième saison de la German Race Wars, des visiteurs de plus de 20 pays font un pèlerinage à ce méga-événement. Et : La Mini John Cooper Works est la version de course du bolide bavarois. Arden le transforme en l'Arden Mini AM 3.

programme.title: Tuning
programme.desc: Pour le préparateur BMW Manhart Racing, la Nordschleife du Nürburgring est l'endroit idéal pour célébrer son 25e anniversaire. Dans le cadre des Track Days, les clients et les personnes intéressées ont la possibilité de faire connaissance avec les modèles Manhart.

programme.title: Tuning
programme.desc: Une fois par an, les amateurs de tuning automobile de tout le pays se retrouvent au Neue Messe Dresden pour le XS Carnight. Sur 35 000 mètres carrés, on peut y voir des voitures de rêve alors que les lumières s'éteignent à l'extérieur.

programme.title: Tuning
programme.desc: Contrairement aux innombrables réunions de voitures Show & Shine, au Rust'n'Roll, plus c'est vieux, mieux c'est. Ce n'est que lorsque les véhicules ont l'air vraiment vieux et sont aussi rouillés que possible qu'ils sont considérés comme beaux.

programme.title: Tuning
programme.desc: Le NitrolympX est un événement de sport automobile qui a eu lieu pour la première fois à Hockenheim en 1986. Avec environ 30 000 spectateurs et quelque 300 participants, il s'agit du plus grand événement international de courses de dragsters en Europe.

programme.title: Tuning
programme.desc: La société de tuning SKN de Benstorf organise pour la deuxième fois une journée Dyno. En plus : Lorinser affine la Mercedes E 500 Coupé.Et : un invité chez Räder Motorsport.

programme.title: Auto Union Type C à Monte Carlo
programme.desc: Chaque année, la course de Formule 1 la plus célèbre du monde se déroule ici. Et tous les deux ans, les automobiles d'autrefois, la classe supérieure du sport automobile d'antan, rugissent à nouveau dans les rues de Monte-Carlo.

programme.title: Trackmasters
programme.desc: Quand le Nürburgring se transforme en un merveilleux monde hivernal, cela peut sembler plaisant à admirer, mais c’est tout l’inverse en tant que piste de course.

programme.title: Trackmasters
programme.desc: Brouillard, pluie et neige ne sont pas les meilleures conditions pour visiter la région d’Eifel. Cependant, les pilotes les plus aguerris étaient sur la piste, et ils n’ont pas laissé la météo se mettre en travers de leur route.

programme.title: Trackmasters
programme.desc: Le Nürburgring est l’endroit où l’on peut réellement se laisser aller sur une piste spectaculaire et difficile, et apprendre comment devenir un vrai pilote. C’est la raison pour laquelle les amateurs de courses s’y rendent durant toute l’année.

programme.title: Trackmasters
programme.desc: Nous vous avons préparé quelques moments très divertissants au Nürburgring. Attendez-vous à voir des pieds au plancher, et de la gomme brûler.

programme.title: Trackmasters
programme.desc: Lorsque les conditions météo au Nürburgring l’ont de nouveau permis, nous avons enfin pu retourner sur la piste de course. Dès que la neige et le verglas ont fondu, les addicts de la puissance sont directement retournés sur le circuit pour faire vrom…

programme.title: Le Sports Car Tour de Bavière
programme.desc: Les voitures de sport permettant également de se balader sont très populaires. Nous essayons l’AMG GT-R en Bavière.

programme.title: Hyundai Veloster Turbo
programme.desc: La Hyundai Veloster est un véhicule qui, délibérément, ne respecte pas les règles de conception. Elle est merveilleusement non-conformiste. Néanmoins, la voiture est appelée un coupé sportif pour souligner ses gènes fougueux.

programme.title: Jaguar XJR
programme.desc: S’il y a bien une berline qui mérite le qualificatif de "dangereuse" et pourrait tout à fait convenir à un gangster chic, c’est la Jaguar XJR.

programme.title: Stihl Timbersports
programme.desc: Le World Trophy a donné le coup d'envoi de la saison, l'élite mondiale ayant enthousiasmé Milan avec des duels acharnés.

programme.title: Stihl Timbersports
programme.desc: Le Rookie World Championship a mis en avant les talents émergents les plus prometteurs de ce sport sur la grande scène.

programme.title: Stihl Timbersports
programme.desc: Au magnifique Zénith Métropole de Toulouse, le Team World Championship a offert une finale palpitante.

programme.title: Stihl Timbersports
programme.desc: Clôturant le calendrier international, le Individual World Championship a offert une finale palpitante.

programme.title: Stihl Timbersports
programme.desc: From axe to saw, the world’s strongest women deliver TIMBERSPORTS action in Germany.

programme.title: Honda CB 1100 EX
programme.desc: Les années 1970 sont de retour. Depuis des années, la nostalgie des motos se répand dans le monde entier. Honda a autrefois produit la première moto à quatre cylindres, la CB 750 Four. Aujourd'hui, les Japonais invoquent leur tradition avec la CB 1100 EX.

programme.title: Car History
programme.desc: Depuis les années 1950, la Mercedes-Benz SL est considérée comme la légende des voitures de sport par excellence. Depuis la légendaire 300 SL et ses portes papillon, la série SL est synonyme d'innovation et de sportivité cultivée.

programme.title: Car History
programme.desc: La Ford Mustang est l'icône de tous les coupés et cabriolets sportifs - aucune autre voiture ne transmet autant le style de vie des années 1960. Avec sa forme et ses moteurs puissants, la Mustang s'est imposée dans le cœur de millions de personnes.

programme.title: Car History
programme.desc: Les Beatles, Peter Sellers, Britt Ekland ou la famille royale britannique, tous ont conduit l'Austin Mini. Conçue sur une serviette de table, la Mini commence une incroyable carrière en 1959 : elle est considérée comme le prototype des petites voitures.

programme.title: Car History
programme.desc: Une voiture que tout le monde connaît et dans laquelle presque tout le monde a roulé, une voiture qui a conquis tous les continents et qui porte un surnom inimitable, la Coccinelle de Volkswagen.

programme.title: Car History
programme.desc: Ferrari - le nom seul fait battre le cœur. Aucune autre voiture de sport ne possède autant de magie et de mythe que les icônes rouges de Maranello. Que ce soit sur la route ou sur le circuit, ces voitures sont au centre de l'attention.

programme.title: Arabella Classics
programme.desc: Des raretés automobiles dans un paysage de rêve. L'Arabella Classics, l'un des rallyes de voitures classiques les plus exclusifs d'Europe.

programme.title: La Lancia Delta S4 chargée d'histoire dans notre test
programme.desc: La Lancia Delta S4 était un vrai gros joueur dans le monde du rallye dans les années 1960, mais l'Italienne fait encore vibrer le cœur de nombreux conducteurs aujourd'hui. Surtout lorsque vous avez la possibilité de conduire cette bête sur le circuit.

programme.title: 4x4
programme.desc: En 2010, BMW et l’écurie de course allemande X-Raid ont décidé de transformer une Mini Countryman en un véhicule tout terrain et de participer au célèbre Rallye Dakar. Ensuite, la Mercedes G63 AMG 6x6, un monstre tout terrain exclusif et extravagant sur 6 roues nous montre ses capacités dans le désert près de Dubaï. Enfin, la Kia Sportage, à l’aise sur les chemins rocailleux comme en ville.

programme.title: 4x4
programme.desc: Les SUV citadins sont la dernière mode dans le secteur automobile. Ils ne sont pas forcément faits pour le tout terrain, mais attirent les consommateurs par leur design moderne et urbain. Dans cet épisode, la Subaru XV nous montre ses capacités tout terrain, et la Nissan Juke affronte le circuit de Dubaï. Ensuite, la Mercedes-AMG et l'Audi RS Q3 GLA s'affrontent dans les montagnes.

programme.title: 4x4
programme.desc: Le Land Rover Defender est l’un des plus vieux modèles de voiture tout terrain. Bien que bruyante et inconfortable, elle est absolument authentique dans sa simplicité. Nous découvrons ce véhicule iconique, et parcourons les 70 ans d’histoire de Land Rover. Ensuite, nous essayons la Range Rover Evoque, le plus récent modèle de la marque britannique, sur la légendaire route de la soie.

programme.title: Toyota MegaCruiser BXD10
programme.desc: Est-ce un Hummer ou un Humvee ? Ni l'un ni l'autre. Le Toyota MegaCruiser BXD10 porte le tout-terrain à un tout autre niveau.

programme.title: Apollo 3500 GT - Design italien et V8 américain
programme.desc: L'Apollo 3500 GT se voulait une alternative aux voitures de sport européennes dont l'entretien était souvent coûteux à l'époque. Une Ferrari américaine, propulsée par un moteur américain : un V8.

programme.title: Motorstories
programme.desc: Quelle est LA voiture américaine des années 60 ? Quel est LE symbole de l’art de la construction automobile américaine ? Pour beaucoup, c’est soit la Corvette, soit la Ford Mustang. Durant sa quête des voitures de rêve des années 60, Tillmann Miritz fait une découverte surprenante en Floride (Ford Mustang 1964).

programme.title: Motorstories
programme.desc: Quelle est LA voiture américaine des années 60 ? Quel est LE symbole de l’art de la construction automobile américaine ? Pour beaucoup, c’est soit la Corvette, soit la Ford Mustang. Durant sa quête des voitures de rêve des années 60, Tillmann Miritz fait une découverte surprenante en Floride (Ford Mustang 1964).

programme.title: Motorstories
programme.desc: Il n’y a pas beaucoup de choses plus inspirantes pour Ola Stenegard, chef designer des motos BMW, qu’un voyage à travers la Californie. Il rencontre des légendes tels que le designer Ronald Sands ou les customiser Michel "Wooley" Woolaway et Alan Stulberg. Le bandit de Porsche Magnus Walker découvre son admiration pour les motos customisées.

programme.title: Motorstories
programme.desc: Chaque année, 150 000 fans de voitures se retrouvent dans le Nevada pour assister au SEMA à Las Vegas, l’exposition de tuning la plus grande et la plus connue au monde. Parmi eux, la journaliste automobile Kati. Elle rencontre le professionnel du tuning Dirk Hattenhauer, cherche les dernières tendances, et rencontre des célébrités comme le tuner John D’Agostino et le roi du drift Ken Block.

programme.title: Motorstories
programme.desc: Le SEMA Show à Las Vegas est l’exposition de tuning la plus grande et la plus connue au monde. On trouve tout ici. Mais ces voitures ne sont pas là que pour être exposées. Dans les faits, pratiquement tous les exposants présentent leurs travaux durant la légendaire démo roulante. Et durant la fête qui suit : "SEMA Ignited", ils font fondre l'asphalte.

programme.title: Toyota GT 86 J-Sport
programme.desc: La Toyota GT 86 de J-Sports montre que les racines de cette entreprise de préparation automobile sont ancrées dans la course. Mais les souhaits des fans de donner à la voiture japonaise une puissance fortement accrue sont restés insatisfaits. Heureusement Toyota travaille déjà sur une version plus efficace, qui offrira de nouvelles possibilités en termes d’amélioration de performances.

programme.title: Volvo V60
programme.desc: Qui a inventé les quatre roues motrices ? Tandis que nous visitons le centre d’essai hivernal de Volvo dans l'Autriche enneigée, une pensée nous vient : était-ce les suédois ?

programme.title: Motorvision Specials
programme.desc: Plus de puissance et en plus une consommation économique ? C'est ce que permettrait le chiptuning. Pour le savoir, nous avons envoyé deux équipes faire un road trip du sud de l'Allemagne à Barcelone et retour, soit un total de 3.000 kilomètres.

programme.desc: L'un des plus anciens aérodromes d'Allemagne se trouve à Oberschleissheim, où des pièces d'exposition retraçant plus de 100 ans d'histoire de l'aviation ont été présentées. En plus, nous avons fait un tour au-dessus de la ville à bord d'un Antonov An-2.

programme.title: Motorvision Specials
programme.desc: Précision, high tech, haute qualité. Après plus de 90 ans d'histoire mouvementée, les motos BMW sont considérées comme presque trop parfaites. Nous explorons l'histoire de l'entreprise entre tradition et innovation, avec ses hauts et ses bas.

programme.title: Motorvision Specials
programme.desc: Nature rude, paysages surréalistes, météo imprévisible, mais l'Islande est aussi un paradis pour les amateurs de véhicules à quatre roues, c'est la Mecque du tout-terrain en Europe.

programme.title: Peugeot 108 vs Renault Twingo
programme.desc: Peugeot 108 et Renault Twingo, les deux françaises sont assez similaires, et pourtant fondamentalement différentes. La largement moins coûteuse Peugot 108 est la voiture parfaite pour ceux qui veulent épargner leur porte-monnaie. Mais la 108 a un sérieux adversaire avec la troisième génération de Renault Twingo.

programme.title: Des Classiques "Ostalgie" de Uwe Steimle
programme.desc: Le commissaire de police de la télévision allemande Uwe Steimle présente son choix de voitures classiques de la RDA : Wartburg Camping et Skoda Felicia Cabrio.

programme.title: 4x4
programme.desc: En 2010, BMW et l’écurie de course allemande X-Raid ont décidé de transformer une Mini Countryman en un véhicule tout terrain et de participer au célèbre Rallye Dakar. Ensuite, la Mercedes G63 AMG 6x6, un monstre tout terrain exclusif et extravagant sur 6 roues nous montre ses capacités dans le désert près de Dubaï. Enfin, la Kia Sportage, à l’aise sur les chemins rocailleux comme en ville.

programme.title: 4x4
programme.desc: Les SUV citadins sont la dernière mode dans le secteur automobile. Ils ne sont pas forcément faits pour le tout terrain, mais attirent les consommateurs par leur design moderne et urbain. Dans cet épisode, la Subaru XV nous montre ses capacités tout terrain, et la Nissan Juke affronte le circuit de Dubaï. Ensuite, la Mercedes-AMG et l'Audi RS Q3 GLA s'affrontent dans les montagnes.

programme.title: 4x4
programme.desc: Le Land Rover Defender est l’un des plus vieux modèles de voiture tout terrain. Bien que bruyante et inconfortable, elle est absolument authentique dans sa simplicité. Nous découvrons ce véhicule iconique, et parcourons les 70 ans d’histoire de Land Rover. Ensuite, nous essayons la Range Rover Evoque, le plus récent modèle de la marque britannique, sur la légendaire route de la soie.

programme.title: Toyota MegaCruiser BXD10
programme.desc: Est-ce un Hummer ou un Humvee ? Ni l'un ni l'autre. Le Toyota MegaCruiser BXD10 porte le tout-terrain à un tout autre niveau.

programme.title: Apollo 3500 GT - Design italien et V8 américain
programme.desc: L'Apollo 3500 GT se voulait une alternative aux voitures de sport européennes dont l'entretien était souvent coûteux à l'époque. Une Ferrari américaine, propulsée par un moteur américain : un V8.

programme.title: Stunt Heroes
programme.desc: Dans cet épisode les cascadeurs vont pousser un quad dans ses derniers retranchements avec une violente poussée. 100 bars de pression devraient faire voler le quad.

programme.title: Stunt Heroes
programme.desc: Les cascadeurs font l’expérience de la fièvre du tout terrain tandis qu’ils s’amusent avec leurs quads. Et il y aura aussi des sauts excitants et des accidents avec des voitures volant dans les airs.

programme.title: Stunt Heroes
programme.desc: Un camion qui dérape face à un van familial contrôlé à distance. C’est la scène la plus récente que les cascadeurs doivent créer sur leur propre reproduction d’une portion d'autoroute allemande. Le coordinateur Christoph prévoit de séparer le toit du reste du véhicule. Si son idée fonctionne, l’équipe va créer une décapotable de cascade unique.

programme.title: Stunt Heroes
programme.desc: Le cascadeur Dominik Kowalski est un expert en chutes et en cascades impliquant le corps. Mais aujourd’hui, tout est différent car il doit consuire une voiture ! Son objectif est de faire une cascade en traversant un camion ! Domi réussira-t-il à prouver à son équipe qu’il est l’homme de la situation ?

programme.title: Stunt Heroes
programme.desc: Les cascadeurs d’Action Concept doivent créer un saut en moto spectaculaire mais l’accident qui suit serait trop dangereux pour un cascadeur. Le coordinateur Ramazan Bulut doit trouver une solution, l’équipe développe donc un cannon pour la moto. Aura-t-il assez de puissance pour propulser la moto comme souhaité ?

programme.title: Glemseck 101
programme.desc: Une fois par an, les amateurs de café racers, de motos anciennes et de nostalgie se réunissent à Glemseck 101 à Leonberg, en Allemagne - le plus grand événement d'Europe pour les passionnés de moto et les motards.

programme.title: Honda CB 1100 EX
programme.desc: Les années 1970 sont de retour. Depuis des années, la nostalgie des motos se répand dans le monde entier. Honda a autrefois produit la première moto à quatre cylindres, la CB 750 Four. Aujourd'hui, les Japonais invoquent leur tradition avec la CB 1100 EX.

programme.title: Car History
programme.desc: Depuis les années 1950, la Mercedes-Benz SL est considérée comme la légende des voitures de sport par excellence. Depuis la légendaire 300 SL et ses portes papillon, la série SL est synonyme d'innovation et de sportivité cultivée.

programme.title: Car History
programme.desc: La Ford Mustang est l'icône de tous les coupés et cabriolets sportifs - aucune autre voiture ne transmet autant le style de vie des années 1960. Avec sa forme et ses moteurs puissants, la Mustang s'est imposée dans le cœur de millions de personnes.

programme.title: Car History
programme.desc: Les Beatles, Peter Sellers, Britt Ekland ou la famille royale britannique, tous ont conduit l'Austin Mini. Conçue sur une serviette de table, la Mini commence une incroyable carrière en 1959 : elle est considérée comme le prototype des petites voitures.

programme.title: Car History
programme.desc: Une voiture que tout le monde connaît et dans laquelle presque tout le monde a roulé, une voiture qui a conquis tous les continents et qui porte un surnom inimitable, la Coccinelle de Volkswagen.

programme.title: Car History
programme.desc: Ferrari - le nom seul fait battre le cœur. Aucune autre voiture de sport ne possède autant de magie et de mythe que les icônes rouges de Maranello. Que ce soit sur la route ou sur le circuit, ces voitures sont au centre de l'attention.

programme.title: Arabella Classics
programme.desc: Des raretés automobiles dans un paysage de rêve. L'Arabella Classics, l'un des rallyes de voitures classiques les plus exclusifs d'Europe.

programme.title: La Lancia Delta S4 chargée d'histoire dans notre test
programme.desc: La Lancia Delta S4 était un vrai gros joueur dans le monde du rallye dans les années 1960, mais l'Italienne fait encore vibrer le cœur de nombreux conducteurs aujourd'hui. Surtout lorsque vous avez la possibilité de conduire cette bête sur le circuit.

programme.title: Tuning
programme.desc: Le MF5 GT, le powerhouse de Wiesmann. En plus: si vous recherchez l'exclusivité et que vous trouvez que même les performances d'une Mercedes-AMG sont trop faibles, vous êtes au bon endroit à Brabus, un des préparateurs les plus célèbres au monde.

programme.title: Tuning
programme.desc: La forge de tuning MTM est connue pour ses véhicules extrêmement dynamiques, réglés de manière optimale. De plus, le Nissan Juke-R est un projectile aux dimensions d'une boîte à cigares et d'une puissance de 485 ch.

programme.title: Tuning
programme.desc: Tuning World Bodensee est un salon professionnel d'une classe à part. En 2013, un anniversaire très spécial a été célébré : 10 ans plus tôt déjà, les nombreux amateurs de tuning étaient attirés par le lac de Constance pour le début de la saison.

programme.title: Mercedes 300 SL légère
programme.desc: Nous avons eu la chance de tester l'une des 29 Mercedes 300 SL "papillon" construites lors de sa première course au Mille Miglia.

programme.title: BMW M3 E30 – La BMW la plus appréciée de tous les temps
programme.desc: À la fin des années 80, BMW a mis sur le marché une voiture dont la course était l'ADN. Conçue au départ comme un modèle d'homologation pour le Deutsche Tourenwagen Masters, le DTM, elle est finalement devenue l’une des voitures de sport les plus appréciée. Lorsqu’on invoque son nom, les fans de voiture en ont des frissons encore aujourd’hui : la BMW M3.

programme.title: Perfect Ride
programme.desc: Les camping-cars sont de plus en plus populaires - même plus populaires que les SUV. Volkswagen veut aussi une part du gâteau avec le Grand California. Nous testons le Grand California lors d'un trajet dans la nature sauvage de Gran Canaria.

programme.title: Perfect Ride
programme.desc: AMG s'attaque à la Classe A de Mercedes-Benz et crée avec l'A 45 S une véritable machine de course. En plus : le Q3 Sportback, le SUV coupé d'Audi, en test. Et : le Kia XCeed peut-il convaincre par rapport à la concurrence ?

programme.title: Perfect Ride
programme.desc: Comment se comporte la DS7 après six mois d'utilisation ? En plus : la DS7 Crossback peut-elle convaincre un fan inconditionnel de voitures anciennes ? Et : quelle Volvo S60 peut faire mieux ? Le T4 à essence ou le T8 hybride ?

programme.title: Perfect Ride
programme.desc: Opel rafraîchit l'Insignia, en lui donnant un nouveau moteur et de nouveaux phares. En plus : Volkswagen présente le T6.1 avant le lancement du T7. Et : le Nissan Juke peut-il convaincre avec son nouveau design ?

programme.title: Perfect Ride
programme.desc: La sixième génération de l'Opel Corsa montre son côté sportif. En plus : le minimalisme automobile à la perfection, la Mitsubishi Space Star. Et : la Seat Leon 2020 s'attaque à nouveau à la Volkswagen Golf.

programme.title: Perfect Ride
programme.desc: Les nouveaux modèles de la Mercedes-Benz Classe C et de la Skoda Octavia peuvent-ils continuer à surfer sur la vague du succès ? En plus : la nouvelle génération de la Nissan Quashqai et de l'Opel Astra. Et : l'histoire de la Mercedes-Benz Classe C.

programme.title: Perfect Ride
programme.desc: Les fourgeonettes offrent un mélange idéal de fonctionnalité, de polyvalence et de confort. La Mercedes Classe V doit faire ses preuves dans six disciplines. Et l'ID. Buzz, entièrement électrique, peut-il perpétuer l'héritage du Volkswagen Transporter ?

programme.title: Glemseck 101
programme.desc: Une fois par an, les amateurs de café racers, de motos anciennes et de nostalgie se réunissent à Glemseck 101 à Leonberg, en Allemagne - le plus grand événement d'Europe pour les passionnés de moto et les motards.

programme.title: Kia Sorento : le modèle phare de Kia
programme.desc: La Sorento est le fleuron de Kia. Avec elle, les Coréens veulent s'emparer du segment des SUV haut de gamme - avec de la qualité à des prix attractifs. La Sorento répond-elle aux exigences de cette catégorie ou le terme "premium" est-il un peu exagéré ?

programme.title: Motorheads
programme.desc: Les racines de l'iconique marque italienne Lamborghini se trouvent dans le village de Sant'Agata Bolognese. En 1964, Ferruccio Lamborghini voulait créer la meilleure voiture de sport au monde, une décision audacieuse, étant situé à seulement quelques kilomètres de Ferrari. Malgré cela, son premier modèle, la 350GT, a fait mieux que la concurrence de Maranello. Et beaucoup d'autres ont suivi.

programme.title: Motorheads
programme.desc: Le nom de famille Porsche est lié au design automobile, à la construction automobile et à la course depuis le début du 20ème siècle. Après la Seconde Guerre mondiale, suivant les pas de son père, responsable du développement de Volkswagen, Ferry Porsche a mis en place les fondations qui ont donné vie aux modèles de la marque les plus connus tels que la 356 et plus tard, l'iconique Porsche 911.

programme.title: Motorheads
programme.desc: Son nom est connu partout dans le monde. Au début du 20ème siècle, le pionnier automobile Henry Ford a révolutionné le monde de la construction automobile avec la fondation de la Ford Motor Company, la création de lignes de montage dans son usine, et l’iconique modèle T.

programme.title: Porsche Ruf RT35
programme.desc: La Ruf RT35 ressemble peut-être à une Porsche, mais ça n’en est pas vraiment une. Depuis 1981, l’entreprise Ruf, basée à Pfaffhausen en Allemagne, est reconnue comme un constructeur indépendant. Mais les bases de leurs véhicules viennent exclusivement de la marque Porsche. Une Ruf sera néanmoins toujours plus rapide et plus unique qu’une Porsche qui lui ressemble.

programme.title: EN DIRECT : DTM Esports Championship – Lausitzring
programme.desc: La DTM Esports Championship 2026 suit le calendrier des courses DTM cette saison. Les meilleurs simracers s’affrontent lors de plusieurs événements et livrent des batailles intenses pour le titre sur la plateforme RaceRoom.

programme.title: Stunt Heroes
programme.desc: L’équipe de cascadeurs prévoit de mettre en place un affrontement entre l’homme et la machine. Pour une bande démo de leur travail l’un des cascadeurs d’Action Concept fera face à une nouvelle BMW série 3 dans une poursuite pleine d’action dans le site industriel qu’ils ont choisi comme scène principale pour leurs cascades.

programme.title: Stunt Heroes
programme.desc: Il fait chaud dans cet épisode de Stunt Heroes ! Le cascadeur Paul va être englouti par les flammes tandis que tout explose autour de lui dans cette dangereuse mais excitante cascade de feu. L’équipe d’Action Concept prépare avec attention cette scène d’action brûlante.

programme.title: Stunt Heroes
programme.desc: C’est l’heure pour des combats et des boules de feux sur le terrain de jeu de nos cascadeurs. L’équipe d’Action Concept filme une scène de combat qui implique des vitres en sucre et un bus Volkswagen qui vole dans les airs.

programme.title: Stunt Heroes
programme.desc: Les cascadeurs ont un nouveau cannon dans leur arsenal qui leur permet de faire passer une voiture de 0 à 70 km/h en uen seconde. L’équipe avait un outil de ce type auparavant, mais le nouveau ne fait pas de fumée. Désormais, les réalisateurs n’ont pas à retirer la fumée digitalement lorsque la scène est finie. L’équipe essaie l'engin après avoir tourné une scène de poursuite sur une autoroute.

programme.title: Stunt Heroes
programme.desc: Les cascadeurs ont transformé une carrière de gravier en leur laboratoire à cascade. Ils y répètent leurs cascades pour leur employeur principal, la célèbre série allemande "Police de l'Autoroute". Cette fois, une moto sans conducteur vole au-dessus d’une rampe, ils testent une catapulte pour humain et un nouveau coup est essayé dans une scène de combat. La cascadeuse Tina montre ses talents.

programme.title: Le flair suédois et l'ambiance conviviale de la Volvo S90
programme.desc: La Volvo S90. Une suédoise qui respire le calme et la puissance. Avec ses 4 mètres 96, elle est le plus long cuirassé Volvo jamais construit et entre ainsi dans la bataille des berlines de taille moyenne.

programme.title: Melkus RS 1000
programme.desc: Lorsqu'il est question de voitures de la RDA, on pense d'abord aux marques Trabant et Wartburg. Mais peu connaissent la Melkus RS 1000, la seule voiture de sport construite en série en RDA.

programme.title: Quand les Allemands s'accordent avec une Britannique : la Jaguar Arden AJ23
programme.desc: L'entreprise de tuning Arden de Krefeld est spécialisée dans les marques britanniques Mini, Bentley, Range Rover et Jaguar. L'AJ23 est une Jaguar F-Type R modifiée qui est déjà un modèle de série.

programme.title: MOTORVISION.TV #SPOTTED
programme.desc: Le soleil est sorti, les armes sont sorties - il est temps de faire jouer vos muscles ! Aux États-Unis, les riches et célèbres profitent de leur vie luxueuse dans des voitures de sport rapides et excitantes. Les stars du cinéma aiment la Lucra Roadster de "Fast & Furious". La gloire rencontre des icônes comme la Shelby Cobra. Mais en Europe aussi, vous pouvez trouver des voitures chaudes et sauvages. MOTORVISION.TV - #SPOTTED présente les cinq cabriolets ultimes pour les chaudes journées d'été.

programme.title: MOTORVISION.TV #SPOTTED
programme.desc: Lorsque des observateurs de voitures trouvent des voitures rares, c'est comme si on gagnait à la loterie. L'une des voitures les plus exclusives au monde est la Pagani Huayra, qui n'a été construite que 20 fois. Son homologue : la Rimac Concept One, qui entre dans l'histoire en tant que voiture électrique la plus rapide du monde avec une vitesse de pointe de 355 km/h. La Lamborghini Huracan O.CT et la Jaguar F-Type d'Arden promettent une puissance de tuning brutale.

programme.title: Toyota MegaCruiser BXD10
programme.desc: Est-ce un Hummer ou un Humvee ? Ni l'un ni l'autre. Le Toyota MegaCruiser BXD10 porte le tout-terrain à un tout autre niveau.

programme.title: Nature Time
programme.desc: Il est temps de se rapprocher de la nature. Appréciée par tous, tous âges et tous niveaux, NatureTime est une chaîne de streaming gratuite qui propose des histoires captivantes sur la faune et la nature du monde entier.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: We are in beautiful Norway for the kick off of the 2017 MLO Strongman Champions League season. With partly cloudy weather and lots of snow, we have the perfect scenery for the athletes, who prepare for the first contest of the year.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: The SCL Hungary this year is in the AQUAPARK in Budapest, Stage 3 from the spectacular MLO Strongman Champions League, World is Biggest Pro League. With five great events, such as: Viking Press, Farmer's Walk, Deadlift, Conan's Wheel, and A loading race with Beer barrels of 200 Kg. It is a must see!

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: A definite highlight in this FIBO edition in Germany, Strongman Champions League introduced its new rules for a special team item. Graham Hicks tries here to set a New World Record on the biggest log in the world, currently held by Krzysztof Radzikowski. Boosted also by the presence of the acclaimed in the strongman circles names of Mark Felix and Danis Zageris.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: This weekend sees the Strongman Champions League Log Lift World Championships in Lithuania. Big lifting names such as Graham Hicks , Vidas Blekaitis and Vytatus Lalas are in the startlist to push some big numbers.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: The battle of the Dutch will take place this edition in Lichtenvoorde, a place very well known in Holland because of the famous “Black Cross”. The athletes will compete over six heavy events and the winner gets 25 Strongman Champions League ranking points.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Set in the beautiful mountain resort Zlatibor, the fifth stage of the Strongman Champions League 2017 sees 14 athletes from across the world competing for the gold medal of SCL Serbia 2017. The event welcomes top-athlete - and odds-on favourite - Matjaz Belsak (Slovenia), who has presented himself in an impressive shape so far. Can his opponents defeat him?

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: The next two stages take place in Quebec. With eight events over two days, SCL Canada is a true ‘heavyweight’. The athletes compete in: Truck Pull, Deadlift with cars, Log Lift, and the Atlas Stones. The World’s Strongest Viking Jean-Francois Caron from Canada is a favourite, as well as current SCL leader Matjaz Belsak (Slovenia) and promising underdog Jimmy Paquet (Canada).

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Welcome to the second day in Quebec. The athletes are fighting hard to win this two-day event. The last points of this SCL stage can be won over four outstanding disciplines: Power Stairs, Dumbbell Press, Keg Toss, and finally, the legendary Farmer’s Walk. Who will leave Canada with the yellow ‘Leader Shirt’?

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Stages 8 and 9 of the SCL are hosted in Vaasa, Finland, taking place over a spectacular two-day event. After 3 wins so far, Matjaz Belsak from Slovenia plans to extend his lead at the top of the table. Among the other 13 highly motivated strongmen, two SCL legends will make their comeback to the competition: Former World Champion of 2015, Krzysztof Radzikowski (Poland) and Dainis Zageris (Latvia).

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: The fight for the Finnish trophy continues. In this unmissable SCL event, the strongmen battle for the win in the Carry and Drag, the Forward Hold, Deadlifting with Cars and the Loading Race. Belsak, Radzikowski and Zageris look good after the first day, but the others haven’t given up yet.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: This under 105kg category event is the ultimate preparation for up-and-coming strongman athletes before entering the heavy class. The Lightweight World Championship is a special every year in the SCL calendar as it sees new talents rise and many promising athletes who are gearing up for future tournaments. A total of 25 athletes from 16 different countries make their way to Kokkola, Finland

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Situated in the very heart of the Carpathian Mountains, Sibiu is a Romanian town where the climate is pleasantly mild, offering some of the best weather conditions for a strongman event around Europe. All this, without doubt, set the mood for the high results and showtime vibes in Stage 11 of Strongman Champions League. The competition in Sibiu was organized in six different disciplines

programme.title: Strongman Champions League

Curacao is a beautiful Dutch island in the Caribbean, with a great atmosphere to hold another stage of the MLO Strongman Champions League. Let’s see who takes the title here and who will secure a place in the next stage.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League

The contestants race against the clock while pulling a 21-ton truck across the track. One of the most fierce competitors to take part in the event was four-time winner of the World’s Strongest Man competition, Brian Shaw.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League

In front of more than 5000 spectators, the twelve athletes compete in Log Lifts, Card Deadlift, Conan’s Wheel and Loading.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: The first day of the two-part finale sees the strongest men competing in Carry and Drag, Dumbbell Lift and the Truck Pull. Everything is possible in this heated fight for the crown against the backdrop of stunning Chetumal, Mexico.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League

programme.desc: In this episode, the Titan, former double World champion from Latvia will compete against his fellow countryman and the current World champion - Aivars Smaukstelis. With 8 events over 2 stages the contestants are pushed to their limits in Finland.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: SCL Norway is normally all about snow, wind, and cold weather. Our brave athletes are used to compete under conditions few other athletes have competed in, but after COVID delays the competition has been moved from winter to summer bringing in a whole new range of challenges. With an impressive athlete list who will be the winner across 5 cruel events?

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Were in sunny Finland for the next stage of a double-bill of SCL action, but this time its a team event. A truly fantastic event with 6000 spectators. Even during COVID times this was exceptional! 8 Strong Teams where fighting for the title over a crazy 9 events.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Day 2 of the famous Team World championship here in Finland, done over 9 cruel events. In this episode the last and final 5 events take place. 8 Strong Teams are fighting for the title.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: With the next episode of Strongman Champions League Germany. Its the world record breakers, and in the last show we set two new records. Can more be records be broken before the king of the castle is crowned?

programme.title: Strongman Champions League

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Its the second day, and the top 16 athletes have made it through to the final round. With another 4 events to go who will get the crown of world champion?

programme.title: Strongman Champions League

programme.title: Strongman Champions League

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: We are in Alanya, on Turkeys south-coast for the final stop at the end of a mammoth season. Aivars Smaukstellis, the reigning world champion is defending his title, and two-time world champion Dainis Zageris is also here, but with a though competition, who will win?

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: What a day ahead of us here in Alanya, just a handful of events to go before we find out who will be the winner of Strongman Champions League in 2021. These are the world finals, and all the big names are in the house. With just 3 events to go - who will take the crown of World Champion 2021 and be the STRONGEST?

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: We are back, after a short break it feels like we never even left. We’re here in Vaasa - Finland kicking off 2022 new world series. If you are watching at home, just like these people, you’re in the right place. Because this is a special edition world record breaker. The only question left today, is to see how many new world records will be set so stay tuned.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League

The sun is going to be beating down, they’re going to be sweating, hydration is going to be key today. I also reckon they’re all going to be wearing their sunglasses. Let’s see which shady looking character wins.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: So there you have it. The next day, 3 more events in 40 Degrees heat. We’ve got Gavin coming into day 2 leading the pack. Kelvin De Ruiter our world champion struggling a little bit at the moment, but Yoke Race, Conan’s Wheel and then Stones to finish. There is a lot to be played for here, so stay tuned to see if Gavin can take the lead and beat Kelvin overall.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: We’re in the Serbian city of Novi kozarci, for the next stage in the world series. And what a fantastic line up we have for you again. But it is going to be one of the hottest stages yet. A Strongman competition in 44-degree heat. It will be a real challenge for these athletes to finish this event. From all over the world the strongmen came here for the title! Welcome to the heat hell in Serbia.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Welcome to day 2 in Serbia, and its another baking hot one. We are in Kikinda today! We’ve got three more gruelling events for our athletes. Sami Ahola is leading the pack, so can he be the first Finnish athlete to take an SCL title. Stay tuned to find out.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: In this competition, we have our athletes paired up. They’re going to have to take on each event together, having to factor in each other’s strengths and possibly weaknesses. Can the men who normally work alone, share their powers as a duo? Let’s find out!

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Day 2 of the famous Team World championship here in Finland- Joensuu. Welcome to the final day of the world’s strongest team event. The race to be the best team in the world is coming to its crowing point. All is still wide open for any of these to take the title. Who is going to win? Will team Latvia keep their World Title or maybe Finland can attach them? Keep watching and we’ll find out.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Nineteen-year-old Cherylyn says she loves living the high life and admits she is a spoiled and entitled“princess”who has spent tens of thousands of other people’s money on her lavish lifestyle. Cherylyn says she maxed out her 19 credit cards on designer shoes, handbags, purses, clothes, makeup and pampering! And, Cherylyn says she insists on fine dining, fast cars and her boyfriend, Tyler, footing the bill. However, Tyler says he has nothing more to give Cherylyn except an ultimatum, which he delivers when he comes face-to-face with her onstage. Cherylyn's mom, Joey, says that her selfish and manipulative daughter has blown over $130,000 in less than a year and her spending has left a trail of devastation which includes pawning over $7,000 worth of family heirlooms and stealing her identity. Sparks fly when Cherylyn defends her entitled behavior during the taping. What jaw-dropping statement does an unrepentant Cherylyn make to Dr. Phil?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: One man says he caught his wife cheating – on audiotape – but she denies the accusations. Who’s really telling the truth? Dr. Phil gets to the bottom of the alleged affair on tape. Can this relationship survive without trust?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Christina, 21, and her younger sister, Carlie, 13, say they had a close relationship with their father, Michael, until two years ago when he decided to transition to a female. Michael was a police officer, soldier and loving parent who lived his life as a male for 40 years. Now, he wants his daughters to call him Mom, because he says Dad is gone, but they refuse. Michael, who prefers to be called Kayla, says she wants to explain to her daughters why she's living as a woman, but they've never given her the chance. The last time Christina saw her father was two years ago when he showed up at her work in lace and blue jeans to break the news that he's transgendered. When she sees Kayla onstage, does she greet her with open arms? Next, Carlie joins her sister and father. She says she wants her old dad back, but will she feel the same after seeing Kayla? Can the father-daughter bond be turned into a mother-daughter one? Be prepared for an emotional journey as two daughters struggle to understand how someone they loved so much could hurt them so badly.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: You've heard people complain, "If I only knew then what I know now, I wouldn't be in this mess," but what about those times when you choose not to see the writing on the wall? Dr. Phil meets couples who say their relationships went from bad to worse after they said, "I do," and now their families are broken.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Tiffany says her relationship with her son’s father, Erik, was destroyed by his constant lying and empty promises, to the point where she completely cut him off and has not seen him in over three years. Erik admits he has lied to his ex-girlfriends. Then, just this past year, Erik dated Sheka who says after doing research midway through their relationship, she uncovered his lies and put a stop to their wedding plans. So, when did Erik begin to con and deceive people? As Erik is accused of one lie more shocking than the next, his mom, Jody, says her son has been lying since he was a child. And, don't miss part 2, when more women come forward from Erik’s past.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Every bride wants to shine on her special day -- from wearing the perfect gown to hosting the most extravagant reception. But what happens when the dream of the perfect wedding turns into a nightmare? Janae knows about this pain firsthand. Her husband, Michael, got so drunk before the ceremony that he passed out cold after saying “I do” and didn’t wake up until the next day! Janae attended the reception by herself and spent her wedding night with her bridesmaids at a hotel. Their wedding from hell took place two years ago, but she still tears up at the memory of that fateful day. Can she ever forgive Michael's mishaps, or is he doomed to the doghouse forever? Then, Angela is a self-professed bridezilla who makes no excuses for her demanding ways. She even created a newsletter for her bridesmaids with the rules and regulations they must follow to participate in her wedding! Her sister and maid of honor, Vanessa, worries that Angela's nitpicking will cause her fiancé, Marvin, to run for the hills. What's behind Angela's controlling behavior, and is she headed for heartache on her special day?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Daniel Pelosi was convicted of second-degree murder in the slaying of investment banker and multimillionaire Ted Ammon -- the husband of his lover, Generosa. He is currently serving 25 years to life but now claims he is ready to explain what really happened the night of the murder. Dr. Phil visits Pelosi behind bars.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Bill says he believes he is a narcissist after pushing away almost all of his loved ones, including his brother Tom and daughter Bridget, who both stopped speaking to him. After a tense reunion with Tom, Bill gets emotional when Dr. Phil reunites him with Bridget. After violent fights, cruel words, and selfish behavior, will Bill start taking accountability and change?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Would you rather be right or happy? Dr. Phil talks with some right-fighters who can't settle their debate.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Parents are concerned about the extreme measures their daughters take to get and keep a boyfriend.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Pamela says in just nine days, she is likely going to jail for not complying with court orders because she refuses to allow her ex, Justin, his court-ordered visitations with their children. Pamela says she believes Justin is a dangerous narcissist who she claims has locked the kids out of the house and attempted to drown their oldest daughter in the pool. Pamela says she will do whatever it takes to protect her kids from Justin, even if that means going to jail. Justin claims Pamela is a hateful, controlling, bitter ex, who has brainwashed their children into making up stories, and says Pamela’s claims of abuse are lies! These parents have been back and forth to court and claim nothing has been resolved. So, who is telling the truth? Is Justin an abusive father, or is Pamela a jealous ex making up stories for revenge? Can Dr. Phil get these parents on the same page for the sake of their children? Find out!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Contemporary weddings have turned into five-star productions, with couples pulling out all the stops to shine on their special day. But what happens when the bride or groom-to-be starts making diva-like demands? Mike and Jamie agreed to a small Vegas wedding, but that went out the window when Jamie switched her gown three times, rented a limo to drive her one block and upgraded her engagement ring. Mike says that Jamie also made him uninvite all of his friends and cancelled his bachelor party! Are Jamie’s antics a hint of what’s to come in their marriage? Then, Nastassia complains that her husband-to-be, Richard, is cheap. She says he wants her to buy bridal flowers from the grocery store, have her mom sew her gown and even schedule the wedding before year's end so he can get a tax write-off! Will Richard’s tightwad ways force Nastassia to call off the wedding?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: In the last 10 years, the number of women arrested for driving drunk has risen by 30 percent, and police report that more and more young children are sitting in the back seat when these moms are pulled over.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Do you know someone who turns your stomach or makes you cringe the minute he or she walks into the room? Dr. Phil talks to guests who say their relative's rude behavior keeps them on edge.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: A Meddling Mother-in-Law or a Lying Cheating Daughter-in-Law? Dr Phil delves into the family drama.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: More couples get divorced in the first year of marriage than any other. Dr. Phil talks with newlyweds in crisis about having realistic expectancies and re-negotiating within the relationship.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: We've all heard of in-laws who don't get along, but these guests say their problems have become scary and even life-threatening.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Amanda says her husband of two years, Jeffrey, was recently caught in an online child sex sting and sentenced to five years in prison, yet she’s not sure if she should leave him. Why does she say she blames herself for what happened? And, hear from Amanda’s parents, Juliet and Timothy, who say they just want their daughter to move on. When Dr. Phil gives Amanda a harsh dose of reality, will she see the situation for what it is? Then, 18-year-old Seri says that two years ago, she fell in love with 26-year-old Hector, who convinced her to quit school and become a prostitute — and give him all the profits. Hector was convicted of sexual assault of a child and is now serving up to 30 years in prison. Seri is raising their daughter and has a new boyfriend, Will, but she admits that she would consider taking Hector back, if given the opportunity. Why does Seri say she still has feelings for her abuser?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: A mother describes her daughter's self-destructive behaviors.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Who will Brad choose: his wife or girlfriend?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: George and Cindy Anthony speak out for the first time about their daughter, Casey's trial.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil wants a violent teen to meet someone who could change her life. How will she react?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: From spending $600,000 on 3-year-old beauty queens, to pushy stage sisters and an ambitious boxing coach — today's guests say they go to the extremes to help the youngest members of their family excel. Meet two fathers, one whose full-time job is managing his tiny stars' careers, and the other who hand makes each and every one of his 4-year-old daughter's costumes. Are these dads bonding with their daughters or simply pushing too hard? Plus, meet several women who defiantly criticize child beauty pageants. And, hear from one overzealous sister and the father of a boxing champion once ranked first in the world. Can Dr. Phil convince these guests to step aside and strive for balance in their children's lives?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil gives family freeloaders a wake-up call.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Melanie says her 19-year-old daughter's boyfriend, Michael, is a gay, drug abusing gangbanger. What would cause her to have such a negative opinion of him? And is there any truth to her allegations? Learn why Michael initially agrees to a drug test, and then refuses. Will he finally break down and take it? And why does Melanie’s daughter, Caylin, support him anyway, regardless of the outcome? Then, Lori says her 17-year-old daughter, Mackenzie, is obsessed with a boy who's already broken up with her four times. Find out why Dr. Phil has a stern message for this mom.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: In Part 3 of the Man Camp Series, couples fighting to save their marrages deal with family issues, infidelity, and unexpected visitors.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: "I wanted to make someone jealous." "I was bored." "I wanted to feel closer to God." These are just a few of the 237 reasons why women say they have sex. Author and clinical psychologist Dr. Cindy Meston and Dr. Jennifer Berman, a sexual health expert, join Dr. Phil to talk about women and sex, and offer advice to couples with differing libidos.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: When you imagine getting an inheritance, will your financial problems be solved or can the money be more trouble than it’s worth?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: A woman attempts to confront her cheating husband with his alleged mistresses.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: How well do you know your neighbors, your friends or even your child's teacher? An estimated four to eight million people in North America are swinging in the suburbs " mostly middle-class folks from all walks of life. Dr. Phil takes you inside the secret world of swingers, a lifestyle where couples swap partners.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: He’s a tough-guy afraid of loosing his freedom. She’s been through two ugly divorces. So when the “M” word comes up, they head for the hills. Join these commitment-challenged singles as Dr. Phil uncovers the reasons why they won’t take the plunge. You’ll also meet a man who, after a four years in a loving relationship, doesn’t see the need to get married. To him it’s just a piece of paper. To her it’s a lot more. Find out if it’s really a “deal breaker.”

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: A father is fighting for custody of his 4 children because his ex-wife is allegedly in a cult.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Em says her husband, Shawn, has cheated on her with at least 78 women -- so why does she keep taking him back? Shawn admits to at least 20 affairs but says it’s his wife’s fault that he strays.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: For the first time, a woman meets her soon-to-be daughter-in-law, whom she has called manipulative, immoral and disrespectful.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Are deadbeat dads actually dead broke dads? As the American economy struggles, men comprise most of the recent layoffs. In child support cases, are men and women treated equally in the courts, or are the laws out of touch with today's crisis? Dr. Phil's guests, along with Mel Feit, director of the National Center for Men, and Lis Wiehl, author and legal analyst, debate the issue that has many men feeling like the laws are against them.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Daniel Pelosi was convicted of second-degree murder in the slaying of investment banker and multimillionaire Ted Ammon -- the husband of his lover, Generosa. He is currently serving 25 years to life but now claims he is ready to explain what really happened the night of the murder. Dr. Phil visits Pelosi behind bars.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Craig and Cherie say the last half of their 16-year marriage has been anything but happily-ever-after. Cherie says Craig is chauvinistic, verbally abusive and demands sex, which she admits she only gives him about three to four times a year. Craig says Cherie withholds sex to control him, and as a result, he has become a slave to his anger. Cherie fears the tension in their household is taking a toll on their 11-year-old daughter, who is often caught in the crossfire of their fighting. Dr. Phil challenges the couple to a communication test. Can they heal their wounds and rekindle their romance? Then, meet the couple who inspired the movie, The Vow. Shortly after Kim and Krickitt Carpenter were married, a terrible car crash changed everything. Krickitt lay in a coma for weeks, and awoke with no recognition of her husband. The couple shares their inspiring, though oftentimes heartbreaking, journey of falling in love all over again. How did they find their way back to each other? And what is it like seeing their lives played out on the big screen? If you’ve ever wondered whether love can survive the toughest of challenges, you won’t want to miss this show! This show contains strong sexual content. Viewer discretion advised.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Millions were inspired by the first “Role of the Man” show. Now, Dr. Phil is making it an ongoing series and checking in with past guests. Remember the husband who provided everything for his wife…except intimacy? He’s back! Are they now sleeping in the same bed? Then, you’ll hear from the man who wanted his wife to have sex with him on demand. Did he change his selfish ways or is he still in the doghouse? Plus, what’s a mama’s boy to do when his wife insists he cut the umbilical cord once and for all?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: What’s a woman to do when her spouse is constantly standing over her shoulder and nitpicking everything she does? Michelle says her husband, Jim, has controlled her for the 15 years that they’ve been together, and she’s fed up with his faultfinding. She says he tells her what to wear, how much she should eat, and even uses a GPS to track her whereabouts! Jim admits that his behavior is out of control and fears that he could be pushing his wife out the door. Why is he so critical of Michelle, and can Dr. Phil get the judgmental hubby to change his ways? Then, Sally says her husband, John, is so controlling that she spends most of her days picking up dust bunnies from the floor and only speaking when he allows her to. John says cleanliness is next to godliness and believes control is a matter of perception. See what causes him to go toe to toe with Dr. Phil! Will the couple get the help they’re seeking? It’s an explosive Dr. Phil you don’t want to miss!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: A 7-year-old boy's knives fascination and violent imaginary friend injured teachers.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Parents Liz and Jim say their 16-year-old son, Nic, has a serious drug problem that has such a hold on him, they claim he even stole $75,000 in gold from his parents’ safe and spent it all on drugs! But, Liz says she is convinced that her husband is to blame. Liz accuses Jim of being a narcissist and misogynist, whose parenting philosophy is based on intimidation and abuse, and claims that is what drove their son to drugs. Jim denies Liz’s allegations, claiming she has gone to great lengths to paint him as a villain. He says she is the major problem, and calls her the world's lousiest parent and a doormat who helped enable Nic's deadly addictions.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: A mother says her teen daughter is aggressive, violent and a bully who crossed a line when she threatened to shoot her teacher and other students.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Do you ever feel nervous before posting on social media? Have you ever censored your own thoughts because you worry that you could be criticized or even canceled for posting your beliefs? Dr. Phil and his guests discuss the self-censorship debate on the internet and social media, including the fundamental misunderstanding about the true extent of “freedom of speech” under the First Amendment. Kimberly, a University of Tennessee doctoral candidate, claims her college violated her freedom of speech after a professional conduct committee determined that she had posted unprofessional content to her social media. What rights do colleges have to spy on personal social media posts? Also Tehran Von Ghasri, a comedian who performs on college campuses, says cancel culture gone too far. How does the fear of being canceled affects the jokes he performs for college students or content he posts online? Alexandra, a social media influencer and business owner, says giving opinions about COVID got her censored and three accounts closed. What did she say to get canceled? Dr. Phil also talks with Attorney Robert Shibley, a Senior Fellow at the Foundation for Individual Rights and Expression (FIRE), who says over half of Americans are not saying how they feel for fear of offending others or being canceled. Jessica Levinson, an attorney and a Clinical Professor of Law at Loyola Law School, provides an explanation on the boundaries of the First Amendment. And, Gabrielle Gambrell, a Columbia University and NYU professor, says that social media sites are obligated to monitor hate and dangerous speech. Plus, find out which emojis you are probably using right now are deemed outdated or inappropriate!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Laurie-Ann emailed Dr. Phil claiming she was robbed by her dangerous, narcissist ex-boyfriend and his new fiancée, Alison. She claims her ex, Michael, held her hostage for seven years. Laurie-Ann claims Michael and Alison are retaliating against her for breaking her silence and filing charges against Michael for domestic violence, emotional abuse, theft, and fraud. But Michael and Alison say Laurie-Ann is a liar who is always playing the victim. Michael says he never held her hostage; she only started to say that because he dumped her. Alison says she just wants Laurie-Ann to move on with her life, let them be happy, and stop stalking them. But Laurie-Ann says Alison doesn’t know how vindictive Michael really is and she claims he has turned everyone, including the police, against her. Laurie-Ann says she wants Dr. Phil to validate her story.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Beka is a mom of three teenage girls who she says are angry, violent and out of control. She says an argument with her oldest daughter Arielle escalated to a life-threatening altercation when the 16-year-old stabbed her with a kitchen knife. Arielle was arrested and sent to juvenile detention for the incident, but is she remorseful? And are her 15-year-old identical twin sisters following in her footsteps? Beka says they are "evil" and have threatened to kill her too. But the twins tell a different story, claiming Beka is the one who is manipulative and abusive. They say she drinks excessively, has choked them and has even tried to take her own life. Can Dr. Phil get to the root of the real problem in this tumultuous household? Beka's husband, Jody, weighs in. Plus, Dr. Phil delivers a shocking message to this family in crisis -- Don't miss it.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Terrell Owens is a six-time NFL pro-bowler and arguably one of the best wide receivers to play the game, but he may be better known for his antics off the field. His tumultuous career has been well-documented, and he's been called arrogant, toxic and friendless. The football great sits down with Dr. Phil to set the record straight about the bad rap he says he’s been getting, especially from the mothers of three of his children, who claim he's also a deadbeat dad who is behind on child support payments and makes little attempt to see his kids. What does Terrell think of their accusations? See what happens when the moms come together to confront the alleged absentee dad on Dr. Phil's stage about missed birthday parties, ignored phone calls and empty promises. Is Terrell living in the lap of luxury while his kids go without? What kind of relationship does he want with his children? Dr. Phil delves into Terrell's past to help him create a better future for his children. Plus, at 38, will he play in the NFL again?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Imagine your pregnant teen daughter running away to be with the baby's father -- an older man whom she met online. For Heidi, this became reality when her 15-year-old daughter, Brittney, went missing for five weeks. Dr. Phil put private investigator and former FBI Agent Harold Copus on the case to find the missing teen. See the confrontation when Harold finally locates her and her 34-year-old boyfriend. Then, find out why Brittney was even more upset when she found out what was in store for her. It's been two months; has Brittney's relationship with her mother improved? Next, Kim, 15, has run away six times in the last year, most recently making it halfway across the country to be with her married boyfriend. Why didn't her parents look for her, and why does she say she'll do anything to get away from them? Can this family learn to get things back on track? Think your child is being targeted by a sexual predator? Don’t miss Dr. Phil’s warning signs!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: A woman says her ex-husband enables their daughter's addiction.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Jessica says her mother, Patricia, claims she is defying the odds by becoming a record-setting weight lifter while simultaneously battling Stage 3 brain cancer. But Jessica insists her mother isn’t sick at all and that she is lying about her health to gain sympathy and attention. She says Patricia has been spinning stories about various medical ailments for as long as she can remember -- and it’s time to come clean. Patricia strongly denies her daughter’s accusations and insists her diagnosis and incredible survival story are real. Why does she claim Jessica is out to get her? Emotions run high when mother and daughter meet on Dr. Phil’s stage. Do Patricia’s claims hold up? And, can this mother and daughter repair their fractured relationship?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Tiffany says her relationship with her son’s father, Erik, was destroyed by his constant lying and empty promises, to the point where she completely cut him off and has not seen him in over three years. Erik admits he has lied to his ex-girlfriends. Then, just this past year, Erik dated Sheka who says after doing research midway through their relationship, she uncovered his lies and put a stop to their wedding plans. So, when did Erik begin to con and deceive people? As Erik is accused of one lie more shocking than the next, his mom, Jody, says her son has been lying since he was a child. And, don't miss part 2, when more women come forward from Erik’s past.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Nineteen-year-old Cherylyn says she loves living the high life and admits she is a spoiled and entitled“princess”who has spent tens of thousands of other people’s money on her lavish lifestyle. Cherylyn says she maxed out her 19 credit cards on designer shoes, handbags, purses, clothes, makeup and pampering! And, Cherylyn says she insists on fine dining, fast cars and her boyfriend, Tyler, footing the bill. However, Tyler says he has nothing more to give Cherylyn except an ultimatum, which he delivers when he comes face-to-face with her onstage. Cherylyn's mom, Joey, says that her selfish and manipulative daughter has blown over $130,000 in less than a year and her spending has left a trail of devastation which includes pawning over $7,000 worth of family heirlooms and stealing her identity. Sparks fly when Cherylyn defends her entitled behavior during the taping. What jaw-dropping statement does an unrepentant Cherylyn make to Dr. Phil?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: A divorced couple secretly remarries, but did they make a mistake- again?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: A man accuses his ex-wife and her new husband of killing his children.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: A mom is supposed to love and nurture her children, but what if she's too involved? Reed, 33, says his mother, Margaret, is so meddling, manipulative and controlling that the day she dies will be a cause for celebration, not mourning. He claims she uses bribes to control his every move, including offering him $20,000 to divorce his first wife. Margaret admits that she can be pushy and difficult but says she just wants to see her son succeed in life. Is she really setting him up for failure? Does Reed really want to man-up and break free from his mother's grasp? And, is Margaret willing to let him go? Then, 35-year-old Anthony, star of the new TLC reality show Mama's Boys of the Bronx, says he sees nothing wrong with living at home and letting his mom, Patti, wait on him hand and foot. How does Patti feel about their living arrangement? Will she ever kick Anthony out? Plus, hear how Anthony's lifestyle affects his dating life. If you know of a mother-son bond that's a little too close for comfort, don't miss this Dr. Phil. Reed, 33, says his mother, Margaret, is so meddling and controlling that the day she dies will be a cause for celebration. Margaret says she wants to see her son succeed - but is she setting him up for failure? Plus, 35-year-old Anthony, star of TLC's Mama's Boys of the Bronx, says he sees nothing wrong with living at home.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: The conversation continues with D’Andre, who blames his abusive relationship with his ex-girlfriend, Autumn, on her upbringing.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: A mother who is afraid of her 17-year-old son seeks help.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Moms are accused of bullying their own children.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: A headline making story of a husband’s affair with a co-worker that led to murder. Now the wife and the mistress come face to face for the first time.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Melanie says her 19-year-old daughter's boyfriend, Michael, is a gay, drug abusing gangbanger. What would cause her to have such a negative opinion of him? And is there any truth to her allegations? Learn why Michael initially agrees to a drug test, and then refuses. Will he finally break down and take it? And why does Melanie’s daughter, Caylin, support him anyway, regardless of the outcome? Then, Lori says her 17-year-old daughter, Mackenzie, is obsessed with a boy who's already broken up with her four times. Find out why Dr. Phil has a stern message for this mom.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: How well do you know your neighbors, your friends or even your child's teacher? An estimated four to eight million people in North America are swinging in the suburbs " mostly middle-class folks from all walks of life. Dr. Phil takes you inside the secret world of swingers, a lifestyle where couples swap partners.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: An engagement symbolizes a commitment you make to one special person. But Dr. Phil's guests are accused of the ultimate betrayal: cheating on their spouse-to-be right before walking down the aisle.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Some believe self-censorship is a big problem today, particularly in light of the idea that someone can be "canceled" for their words -- blocked from having a prominent public platform or career for sharing their opinion. Dr. Phil interviews Nate, a former Idaho police officer, who claims he was fired after making a TikTok video about NBA superstar LeBron James that went viral and has been viewed over 4 million times. Nate explains how the fall-out from the video affected him and his family, too. Dr. Phil also speaks with conservative political commentator Tomi Lahren, who says she recently had to be protected by state police from student protestors at the University of New Mexico. Greg Lukianoff, president of the Foundation for Individual Rights and Expression, says he believes Americans have lost the ability to discuss their differences rationally. And, Dr. Shaun Harper, founder and Executive Director of the USC Race and Equity Center, says he is firmly against hate speech and feels people need to be more mindful about the effects of their words.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: George and Cindy Anthony speak out for the first time about their daughter, Casey's trial.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: More couples get divorced in the first year of marriage than any other. Dr. Phil talks with newlyweds in crisis about having realistic expectancies and re-negotiating within the relationship.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Bill says he believes he is a narcissist after pushing away almost all of his loved ones, including his brother Tom and daughter Bridget, who both stopped speaking to him. After a tense reunion with Tom, Bill gets emotional when Dr. Phil reunites him with Bridget. After violent fights, cruel words, and selfish behavior, will Bill start taking accountability and change?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: TV Star Nicholas Brendon has been starring in his own private alcohol-fueled drama which has led to multiple arrests and been documented in celebrity magazines, social media and blogs. Nicholas sits down with Dr. Phil -- and abruptly walks offstage. Is Nicholas ready to take the steps needed to save his life and career?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Meddling moms who track and monitor their children's lives.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: In the summer of 2014, a former middle school English teacher was arrested on suspicion of statutory rape and contributing to the delinquency of a minor after police found her in a motel room with a 15-year-old former student. In a Dr. Phil exclusive, Jennifer Caswell speaks out for the first time. How does she explain her relationship with her former student?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Did a woman accused of fake pregnancies really lie?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Couples who say their marriage is on the rocks due to debt.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Is there an adult under your roof, eating your food and taking advantage of you financially? If yes, then you live with a moocher! It's time to stop the enabling and start the accountability.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Can married people be friends with someone of the opposite sex without sex getting in the way? At what point does a friendly relationship become an affair of the heart or emotional infidelity? Meet Randy, who says his wife, Amanda, has crossed that line.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: You hear about scams all the time - e-mails and voicemails claiming you have won valuable prizes. Dr. Phil is outraged by what some scammers are doing to him, his family and his viewers. One website offers a Dr. Phil quiz to win $5,000 every hour, another says it has the official Dr. Phil personality test, but even more shocking are 800 numbers that take callers' money for the promise of over the phone therapy with Dr. Phil and Robin. But these 800 numbers connect innocent victims with con artists posing as Dr. Phil staff members. The fake staffers ask anywhere from $375 to $1,000 for consultation time that obviously never takes place.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Demi Moore did it. So did Madonna and Halle Berry. This trend of older women dating younger men is called the Cougar Craze, and it’s sweeping the country. Recently, at a New York speed-dating event, "Sugar Mamas and Boy Toys," good-looking 35-year-old men wooed women over 35 who made at least $500,000 a year. Jeremy organized the event and says he was just answering a demand from affluent ladies. Was he sincere in his matchmaking or just out to make a buck? Dr. Phil talks to two women who participated in the event -- Gail, 44 and Nancy, 50. Their experiences might surprise you. Then, 51-year-old Kat says she’s no cougar; she just likes to date younger guys because men her age are set in their ways. She says her 23-year-old ex-boyfriend, Ryon, was loving, passionate and had a much higher libido than older men. Her friend, Nancy, says Kat has a great head for business, but a bad one when it comes to the opposite sex. She says young men just see dollar signs when they see Kat. Is Kat dating down, or should Nancy just butt out? And, Bobbi had an 11-year relationship with a man who was 17 years her junior, but she says once she turned 50, he saw her as too old. She wants to be in a relationship again, but not with an older man. Her son, Nathan, says someone still wet behind the ears can’t appreciate all Bobbi has to offer. Does Nathan have the right to put his foot down with his mother? Do you think it's OK for older women to date younger men? Take our poll!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: When Pierre, his wife, Amanda, and his mother, Yolande, came to see Dr. Phil, the couple complained his mom was a meddling-mother-in-law. Amanda said Yolande never approved of her, and Yolande admitted she wanted her son to be with a more educated woman. Is this family still at odds?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Do you have a man in your life who stomps his feet, pouts, whines and acts like a toddler? A bride-to-be is dealing with an immature fiance and a meddling mother-in-law, and a mooching groom is living in his mom's basement with his common-law wife and baby. Today's guests are grown men whose loved ones want them to grow up!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Celebrities seem to do it every day: short engagements and quick marriages. In his book, Love Smart: Find the One You Want - Fix the One You Got, Dr. Phil says everybody deserves a loving relationship, but there is a right way, a smart way, to find your Mr. or Ms. Right. Do fast engagements and marriages work, or is it a recipe for disaster?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: It's do or die for the men today, as their partners tell them to either walk down the aisle or walk the highway! Plus, Robin has tips for maintaining a healthy relationship.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Four engaged couples wondering if they're ready to walk down the aisle move into The Dr. Phil House. Each couple will be put to the test to see if they really know their partner's flaws, funds, family and future expectations. After several challenges, will the couples decide to head to the altar or just call it quits? Lacey says her fiancé, Kalin, has pushed, choked and cheated on her, all while she was pregnant with their child. Kalin says he knows he had an anger problem, but claims he hasn't cheated since their baby was born. Steve is afraid of displeasing his fiancée, Stephanie, who wants to be treated like a princess. He says nothing he does is right, and anything can set off her temper. Stephanie wants more attention from Steve but is unsure if their wedding will happen because of the fighting. Scott thinks his wife-to-be, Lisa, tears down his dreams of being a musician, while Lisa thinks Scott is a male chauvinist with immature and unrealistic dreams. Tim and Lilly are just 19 years old and aren't sure they're prepared for their baby, due in two months. They want to get married but can't afford a ring or a wedding. Part 1 summary: After moving into The Dr. Phil House, Kalin gets his first assignment. Since Lacey says Kalin hasn't helped with their daughter since she was born 11 months ago, he has to care for a computerized baby that will record how well he meets its needs. The couples' first challenge is a game called Hitched or Ditched, where the couples have to guess how their partners will answer certain questions. Lisa and Scott win the game, but others question whether Scott cheated.

programme.desc: The atmosphere at Mumbai's Jio World Garden is electric as the host team, Mumbai Pickle Power, rides the momentum of their first season victory into a high-stakes clash against the Rajasthan Titans. With Rajasthan still hunting for their elusive first win of the season, the pressure is at a breaking point for both squads as they fight to climb the "Band of Honor" leaderboard. Witness tactical masterclasses as veteran Lorena Dupnik faces off against Jada Bui in a strategic battle of precision, and feel the intensity of the men's singles where superstars like Brandon Lane and Jack Foster showcase explosive athleticism. From game-changing "Pickle Plays" to high-stakes challenges and the presence of celebrity guests like Rishabh Pant, every rally in this tie is a desperate fight for survival on the road to the semifinals.
